title: viburnum plicatum var. lanceatum
intro: Viburnum plicatum var. lanceatum, commonly known as the Japanese Snowball, is a deciduous shrub native to East Asia, characterized by its showy white flowers and fragrant foliage. The health benefits of Viburnum plicatum var. lanceatum include its potential to reduce inflammation and promote wound healing due to its antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to exhibit sedative, anti-anxiety, and anti-inflammatory effects, making it a potential natural remedy for stress relief and skin issues. Bioactive constituents of Viburnum plicatum var. lanceatum include tannins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
